relationships.label: Cleromancy depends on Genet

relationships.label: Cleromancy depends on Mere
relationships.explanation: Cleromancy Cargo.toml pins Graphshell, Cambium, and the Mere graph and persistence crates from merely-made/mere. Verification recorded on 2026-10-06 (derived).

relationships.label: Cleromancy depends on Turquet
relationships.explanation: Cleromancy Cargo.toml uses Turquet for the optional analytic-ephemeris and sky-timeline features. Verification recorded on 2026-10-06 (derived).

relationships.label: Genet depends on Netrender
relationships.explanation: Genet Cargo manifests use git packages from merely-made/netrender. Verification recorded on 2026-07-29 (derived).

relationships.label: Genet depends on Vano
relationships.explanation: Genet's root Cargo manifest resolves nova_vm from merely-made/vano. Verification recorded on 2026-07-30 (derived).

relationships.label: Genet depends on wgpu-scry
relationships.explanation: Genet Cargo manifests use the scrying package from merely-made/wgpu-scry. Verification recorded on 2026-07-29 (derived).

relationships.label: Genet renders with Netrender
relationships.explanation: Genet's README identifies Netrender as the realization engine for Genet paint lists. Verification recorded on 2026-07-29 (curated).

relationships.label: Isocosm depends on Genet
relationships.explanation: Isocosm's root Cargo manifest (the VTT, formerly Isometry) uses Genet's layout, scripted-DOM, and probe packages from merely-made/genet. Verification recorded on 2026-09-04 (derived).

relationships.label: Isocosm depends on Mere
relationships.explanation: Isocosm's root Cargo manifest (the VTT, formerly Isometry) uses Mere graph, replication, identity, and scene packages, and takes Cambium, its Genet winit host, and Sprigging from there since they moved to Mere on 2026-09-03. Verification recorded on 2026-09-04 (derived).

relationships.label: Isocosm depends on Netrender
relationships.explanation: Isocosm's root Cargo manifest (the VTT, formerly Isometry) uses rendering packages from merely-made/netrender. Verification recorded on 2026-07-29 (derived).

relationships.label: Knot Editor depends on Genet
relationships.explanation: Knot Editor's workspace manifest resolves Fleece, genet-host-api, genet-probe, genet-scripted-dom, and layout-dom-api from merely-made/genet at one revision. Verification recorded on 2026-09-04 (derived).

relationships.label: Knot Editor depends on Mere
relationships.explanation: Knot Editor's workspace manifest resolves its Mere graph, identity, transport, and host packages, and Cambium, Illume, Inker, and the Knot editor host, from merely-made/mere at one revision. Verification recorded on 2026-09-04 (derived).

relationships.label: Mere depends on Emblem
relationships.explanation: Mere Cargo.toml declares emblem 0.2.0 for IconVG faces. Verification recorded on 2026-10-06 (derived).

relationships.label: Mere depends on Genet
relationships.explanation: Mere Cargo manifests use Genet's host, document, layout, render, and engine packages. The Cambium user-interface family is no longer among them; it moved into Mere on 2026-09-03. Verification recorded on 2026-09-04 (derived).

relationships.label: Mere depends on Knot Editor
relationships.explanation: Mere's root Cargo manifest resolves knot-editor and knot-document from merely-made/knot-editor; Djinn consumes the editor through that workspace entry. Verification recorded on 2026-09-04 (derived).

relationships.label: Mere depends on Mora
relationships.explanation: Mere Cargo.toml declares mora 0.1.0 and the mora-cmudict adapter. Verification recorded on 2026-10-06 (derived).

relationships.label: Mere depends on Netrender
relationships.explanation: Mere Cargo manifests use rendering packages from merely-made/netrender. Verification recorded on 2026-07-29 (derived).

relationships.label: Mere depends on Retinue
relationships.explanation: Mere's root Cargo manifest uses Retinue from merely-made/retinue. Verification recorded on 2026-07-29 (derived).

relationships.label: Mere renders with Genet
relationships.explanation: Mere's README identifies Genet as its HTML engine and product-neutral host layer. Verification recorded on 2026-07-29 (curated).

relationships.label: Retinue depends on Pipit
relationships.explanation: Retinue crates/outrider/Cargo.toml uses pipit 0.2 behind the optional voice feature. Verification recorded on 2026-10-06 (derived).

relationships.label: Turnstone depends on Genet

relationships.label: Turnstone depends on Knot Editor
relationships.explanation: Turnstone's root Cargo manifest resolves knot-editor and knot-document from merely-made/knot-editor. Verification recorded on 2026-09-04 (derived).

relationships.label: Turnstone depends on Mere
relationships.explanation: Turnstone's root Cargo manifest uses Mere graph, host, memory, identity, and scene packages, and takes Cambium, Workbench, Sprigging, Inker, and the surface API from there since they moved to Mere on 2026-09-03. Verification recorded on 2026-09-04 (derived).

relationships.label: Turnstone depends on Netrender

relationships.label: Woodshed depends on Genet

relationships.label: Woodshed depends on Mere
relationships.explanation: Woodshed resolves Cambium, Sprigging, Workbench, Tinct, the surface API, scenes, identity, and storage packages from one immutable merely-made/mere revision; its headed P4e receipt passed after the 2026-09-04 repoint. Verification recorded on 2026-09-05 (derived).
